description: Full set of accepted `package-ecosystem` values in .github/dependabot.yml. Used as the reference list against which DEPENDENCY_ECOSYSTEMS in src/fix.update-dependencies.lib.mjs was checked for coverage.
notes: `hex` is the Elixir ecosystem; its manifest is mix.exs / mix.lock.
`pip` covers requirements.txt, Pipfile, pyproject.toml (setuptools and Poetry v2); `uv` is a separate value for uv.lock.
`npm`, `yarn`, `pnpm` and `bun` all read package.json but differ in lockfile.
Dependabot version updates are per-directory and per-ecosystem: a polyglot repository needs one `updates:` entry per (ecosystem, directory) pair.
